title: 游戏频繁崩溃与冻结
description: 游戏在保存、加载、特定场景或随机情况下频繁崩溃、冻结或卡死，导致游戏中断，需要重启或重载。
evidence: saved and instant crash to desktop
Game is crashing on every save attempt.
While in main menu adjusting settings I crashed the game and forced a restart.

evidence_items.quote: there are so many bugs and alot will kill your game not just be annoying
evidence_items.description: 大量bug会导致游戏崩溃，不只是烦人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有太多bug了，而且很多会直接毁掉你的游戏，不只是烦人而已

evidence_items.quote: every single one of my runs was eventually killed by a bug
evidence_items.description: 游戏运行因bug而崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的每一次游玩最终都被一个bug给毁了

evidence_items.quote: Finaly the game crashes like 10 times less then it was
evidence_items.description: 游戏崩溃次数减少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 终于，游戏崩溃的次数比原来少了大概10倍

evidence_items.quote: my game crashed in the first hour of playing
evidence_items.description: 游戏在游玩第一小时内崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的游戏在玩的第一小时就崩溃了

evidence_items.quote: I had to reload the game several times due to patrol ships crashing into me at 400m/s because they don't know how to safely dock and just keep accelerating.
evidence_items.description: 巡逻船以400m/s撞向玩家导致需要重载游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不得不重载游戏好几次，因为巡逻船以400米/秒的速度撞上我，它们不知道怎么安全停靠，只会一直加速。

evidence_items.quote: The game crashes when you load a save from in-game
evidence_items.description: 从游戏内加载存档时崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你在游戏内加载存档时，游戏会崩溃

evidence_items.quote: there is still a problem with the garbage collection and commands. The longer you play the game the more likely you will encounter something
evidence_items.description: 垃圾回收和指令相关的问题，游玩越久越容易出现
evidence_items.quote_zh: 垃圾回收和命令仍然存在问题。你玩得越久，就越有可能遇到某些问题

evidence_items.quote: Game is crashing on every save attempt.
evidence_items.description: 每次尝试存档时游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏在每次尝试保存时都会崩溃。

evidence_items.quote: the game has crashed out
evidence_items.description: 游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏崩溃了

evidence_items.quote: I've lost countless hours combined from crashes and corrupt saves
evidence_items.description: 游戏频繁崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为崩溃和存档损坏，我累计损失了无数小时

evidence_items.quote: could not play like 2 hours without crashing 5 times
evidence_items.description: 游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩不到2小时就崩溃了5次，根本没法玩

evidence_items.quote: I was experiencing a ton of crashes when I first started, still crashes, but now that I've restarted a new run, it's rare.
evidence_items.description: 游戏频繁崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我刚开始玩的时候经历了大量崩溃，现在仍然会崩溃，但自从我重新开始新的一轮后，就很少发生了。

evidence_items.quote: your game will crash sometimes
evidence_items.description: 游戏有时会崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的游戏有时会崩溃

evidence_items.quote: an interactable object may break your game
evidence_items.description: 可交互物体可能导致游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个可交互物体可能会让你的游戏崩溃

evidence_items.quote: caidas ocacionales
evidence_items.description: 游戏偶尔崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 偶尔崩溃

evidence_items.quote: The game freezes for too long whenever it auto saves
evidence_items.description: 自动保存时游戏冻结过久
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每当游戏自动保存时，它都会冻结太久

evidence_items.quote: i get crash when turning game off
evidence_items.description: 关闭游戏时发生崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我在关闭游戏时会崩溃

evidence_items.quote: While in main menu adjusting settings I crashed the game and forced a restart.
evidence_items.description: 在主菜单调整设置时游戏崩溃并强制重启
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在主菜单调整设置时，我把游戏搞崩溃了，被迫重启。

evidence_items.quote: Your game will crash sometimes.
evidence_items.description: 游戏有时会崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的游戏有时会崩溃。

evidence_items.quote: less than an hour into a new playthrough, it crashed at least 5 times
evidence_items.description: 游戏不稳定，新存档不到一小时崩溃至少5次
evidence_items.quote_zh: 新开一局不到一小时，它至少崩溃了5次

evidence_items.quote: constantly locking up every time it auto saves or whenever it randomly gets a whim to do so
evidence_items.description: 自动保存或随机时游戏卡死
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次自动保存时，或者每当它随机心血来潮想这么做时，就会不断卡死

evidence_items.quote: my nav console crashed as I approached OKLG
evidence_items.description: 导航控制台在接近空间站时崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当我接近OKLG时，我的导航控制台崩溃了

evidence_items.quote: the game froze
evidence_items.description: 游戏冻结
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏卡死了

evidence_items.quote: I keep getting loops of errors and crashes. Sometimes it just locks up my whole PC.
evidence_items.description: 出现错误循环和崩溃，有时甚至锁死整个电脑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不断遇到循环出现的错误和崩溃。有时它甚至会把我的整台电脑锁死。

evidence_items.quote: 崩溃
evidence_items.description: 游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 崩溃

evidence_items.quote: encountered only one sudden shutdown and only because of alt-tabing while saving the game.
evidence_items.description: 游戏突然关闭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只遇到过一次突然关机，而且只是因为存档时按了Alt-Tab。

evidence_items.quote: game breaking crashes the rest of the time
evidence_items.description: 游戏大部分时间出现破坏性崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 其余时间则是破坏游戏的崩溃

evidence_items.quote: crashes the moment you think you might have a vague idea what to do
evidence_items.description: 游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就在你以为自己可能对要做什么有了点模糊概念的那一刻，它崩溃了

evidence_items.quote: saved and instant crash to desktop
evidence_items.description: 保存后立即崩溃到桌面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 保存后瞬间崩溃到桌面

evidence_items.quote: constant crashes this game has, it has been happening since they released the 0.11 update
evidence_items.description: 游戏持续崩溃，自0.11更新后出现，导致需要硬重启和重装驱动。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏老是崩溃，自从他们发布0.11更新后就开始这样了

evidence_items.quote: don't enter the security ship if you get boarded for example
evidence_items.description: 进入被登船后的安全船会导致游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 例如，如果你被登船检查，不要进入安保船

evidence_items.quote: shutdowns etc
evidence_items.description: 游戏会关机/崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 关机等等

evidence_items.quote: crashing every 5 minutes
evidence_items.description: 每5分钟崩溃一次
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每5分钟就崩溃一次

evidence_items.quote: I was barely into the tutorial when it crashed on me. Loaded it up again, instant crash.
evidence_items.description: 教程中崩溃，重新加载后立即崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我刚进教程没多久它就崩溃了。重新加载，立刻又崩溃。

evidence_items.quote: after i was done and stood up  from the console every single tile of my ship turned into scrap and the game crashed.
evidence_items.description: 从控制台站起后飞船所有地砖变成废料，游戏崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我完成后从控制台站起来时，我飞船的每一块地板都变成了废料，游戏崩溃了。

evidence_items.quote: I have had one crash in 34 hours (at the time of writing this review) of game-play.
evidence_items.description: 游戏在34小时内崩溃一次
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在34小时的游戏时间中（写这篇评测时），我遇到过一次崩溃。

evidence_items.quote: I've crashed many times due to mapping errors and dead NPCs stacking up in places like KLeg
evidence_items.description: 因地图错误和NPC尸体堆积导致多次崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于地图错误和死掉的NPC在像KLeg这样的地方堆积，我已经崩溃过很多次了

evidence_items.quote: Crashes more often than a cryptocurrency
evidence_items.description: 游戏频繁崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 崩溃得比加密货币还频繁

evidence_items.quote: the game only crashes trying to go past the main menu
evidence_items.description: 游戏在主菜单之后崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏只有在试图越过主菜单时才会崩溃

evidence_items.quote: the experience was marred by bugs and crashes
evidence_items.description: 游戏过程中出现崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 但这段体验被bug和崩溃破坏了

evidence_items.quote: I've had to restart a few times due to soft locking bugs
evidence_items.description: 因软锁定bug不得不重启游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于软锁死bug，我不得不重启了几次。

evidence_items.quote: ui lockups
evidence_items.description: UI锁定
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面卡死

evidence_items.quote: I opened a context menu for a door or something, but it wouldn't let me select anything. Frozen again
evidence_items.description: 打开上下文菜单后游戏冻结
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我为一个门之类的东西打开了上下文菜单，但它不让我选择任何东西。又卡住了

evidence_items.quote: I have restarted multiple times due to game breaking bugs and different stuck situations.
evidence_items.description: 因游戏崩溃性bug和卡死情况多次重开
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于破坏游戏的bug和各种卡住的情况，我已经重新开始了很多次。

evidence_items.quote: You have to restart the prgram after dying
evidence_items.description: 死亡后必须重启程序
evidence_items.quote_zh: 死亡后你必须重启程序

evidence_items.quote: dealing with crashes or glitches
evidence_items.description: 游戏会崩溃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 应对崩溃或故障
